name: scrapersocial
description: Public social media and web data for Gemini CLI via the ScraperSocial MCP server: profiles, posts, comments, search and transcripts from 32 platforms including TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, X and Reddit (231 endpoints).
